method: Online per-champion/per-enemy first-order movement model, reset every match; contexts use last observed movement direction, near/far distance and enemy HP bin. Predict before next observation; labels only when personally visible on consecutive turns and displacement<=3. Models use channel/stationary legality checks consistently. No future or omniscient enemy features.
limitations: Conditional on visibility at the next turn; not a hidden-location accuracy estimate.
Small deliberately selected rank-1 sample with four opponents; not a representative policy-win evaluation.
No game strategy or active bot was changed.
